module.title: Smartphone Widget
module.description: Adds a smartphone-like widget interface for messaging and contacts.

toggleWidget.name: Toggle Smartphone Widget
toggleWidget.hint: Shows or hides the smartphone widget on the screen.

setup.step1_description: Before you start, please select which actor types can own a smartphone. This can be changed later in the GM settings.
setup.error_noActorTypeSelected: Please select at least one actor type.
setup.step2_description: Select an actor to issue the first smartphone to. You can create more phones later in the settings.
setup.error_noValidActors: No actors were found for the selected types.
setup.error_createActorNote: Please create an actor of the selected type first in the Actors sidebar.

main.name: Smartphone Widget Settings
main.label: Open Settings
main.hint: Manage all settings for the Smartphone Widget.

discord.name: GlitchSmith Discord
discord.hint: Visit our Discord server for bug reports, feature suggestions, and support.

gmSettings.title: Target Actor Types
gmSettings.notes: All actor types existing in this world are displayed here. Please select all types that can own or receive a smartphone.

autoMuteDuringCall.name: Auto Mute During Call
autoMuteDuringCall.notes: If this option is enabled, the WebRTC volume of other players not in the call will be automatically set to 0 during the call. It will be restored to the original volume after the call ends.

privateChatLogs.name: Private Chat Logs
privateChatLogs.notes: If this option is enabled, smartphone messages will not be displayed in the main Foundry VTT chat log. Message history will only be saved within the smartphone widget.

gmSettings.appNameNotes: You can change the display name of each app. Leave blank to use the default name.
gmSettings.appConfigNotes: You can customize the display name and icon for each app. Leave the icon path blank to use the default icon (FontAwesome or default image).

phoneSystem.name: Phone Number System Settings
phoneSystem.label: Phone Number Settings
phoneSystem.hint: Manage phone number patterns and related settings.
phoneSystem.allowCustomNumber: Allow players to set their own numbers
phoneSystem.prefixNotes: A 1-4 character combination of letters or numbers (e.g., STD, MIL, A10)
phoneSystem.middleFormatNotes: Enter the desired format combination (e.g., NNAA, XXXX, ANN2)
phoneSystem.lastFormatNotes: Enter the desired format combination (e.g., NNNN, AANN, XX99)
phoneSystem.separatorNotes: Character to use for number separation (e.g., -, #, /, .)
phoneSystem.descriptionNotes: Enter a description for this pattern

notificationVolume.name: Notification Volume
notificationVolume.hint: Sets the volume for message notification sounds.

enableNotifications.name: Message Notifications
enableNotifications.hint: Displays a notification when a new message arrives.

enableNotificationSound.name: Notification Sound
enableNotificationSound.hint: Plays a sound for new message notifications.

currencyManager.name: Banking System Currency Settings
currencyManager.label: Currency Manager
currencyManager.hint: Set the types of currency, exchange rates, and character sheet integration paths to be used in the game world.

targetActorTypes.title: Target Actor Types
targetActorTypes.notes: All actor types existing in this world are displayed below. Please select all types that can own or receive a smartphone.

useGameTime.name: Use In-Game Time
useGameTime.hint: When enabled, all times on the smartphone will follow the in-game world time. When disabled, it will use real-world time.

timeSettings.title: Time & Calendar Settings
timeSettings.label: Time Settings
timeSettings.hint: Set detailed rules for the time and calendar of your TRPG world.
timeSettings.description: The rules set here will apply to both the calendar app and the time on the smartphone.
timeSettings.leapYearDescription: Follows the Gregorian calendar. A leap year occurs 'every X years', but not in 'year Y', and always in 'year Z'.
timeSettings.lightingFXDescription: When enabled, lighting effects will be automatically applied to the current scene based on the in-game time.
timeSettings.lightingFXEnableForScene: Enable Lighting FX for Current Scene
timeSettings.shortcutNotes: Set the target times for the shortcuts displayed in the GM time control panel.
timeSettings.lightingFXAnimateHint: When enabled, the darkness level and color will change gradually. When disabled, they are applied instantly.

syncWithSimpleCalendar.name: Sync with Simple Calendar
syncWithSimpleCalendar.hint: When enabled, the smartphone's time will follow the time set in Simple Calendar. When disabled, the smartphone will use its own independent time, even if Simple Calendar is installed.

appstore.title: App Store Settings
appstore.description: Select which apps appear in the App Store and which are installed by default.

widgetLayerMode.name: Widget Layer Mode
widgetLayerMode.hint: Sets the display priority of the smartphone widget.

gallery.uploadPathHint: Specify the server path where images uploaded via the Gallery app will be stored.
gallery.allowUploadHint: If enabled, players can upload image files from their local computer to the Gallery.

settings.bootLogoHint: Image displayed when the phone powers on.
settings.defaultBootLogoHint: Boot logo shown on phones without a custom one. Leave empty for 'SMARTPHONE' text.
settings.defaultWallpaperHint: Wallpaper automatically applied to newly created phones. Leave empty for the default background.
settings.defaultFrameHint: Frame style automatically applied to newly created phones.

battery.enabledHint: When enabled, phones will consume battery over time. Phones with 0% battery will be locked.
battery.drainRateHint: Percentage of battery drained per in-game hour.
battery.lowThresholdHint: Battery percentage at which a low battery warning is shown.
battery.chargeItemsHint: Drag items onto the phone to charge. Toggle the recycle icon to set whether the item is consumed on use.
battery.chargeAmountHint: Percentage of battery restored when using a charge item.
battery.modeHint: Choose whether the battery system applies to all phones or only selected ones.

time.sourceSelectionNotes: Choose which time system the smartphone widget should follow. The world will reload upon changing.
time.sourceInternalNotes: Uses the independent time and calendar rules built into the smartphone module. Does not integrate with other modules.
time.sourceSimpleCalendarNotes: Follows the time and calendar settings of the installed 'Simple Calendar' module. All time manipulation must be done through Simple Calendar.
time.sourceCalendariaNotes: Follows the time and calendar settings of the installed 'Calendaria' module. Time manipulation is done through the Calendaria UI or its API.
time.sourceSeasonsAndStarsNotes: Follows the time and calendar settings of the installed 'Seasons & Stars' module. Time manipulation is done through Foundry core time or the module's API.
time.sourceSimpleTimekeepingNotes: Syncs with the installed 'Simple Timekeeping' module. Time manipulation is done through the Foundry core time API.
